comparison.objective: Mount a grinding wheel safely on a bench grinder.
comparison.physical_skill: Handle and align a brittle wheel and associated flanges/hardware, then secure the assembly without damage.
comparison.success_condition: Wheel and mounting stack correctly seated and retained, with prohibited damage or unsafe assembly rejected.
comparison.reason: Wheel-stack assembly and safe clamping are mechanically different from tuning an already mounted damper and validating its energy absorption. Generic fastening does not establish overlap.
